about: One-line requests and what New robot must read from them (tests/test_brief_answers.py::test_the_hand_over_table). task: hand_over, not_hand_over or null (either); people: yes (yes or children) or children; estop: the build has an emergency stop. Every row also keeps the invariant that a hand-over has people next to it and an emergency stop. From the round-5 release-review hunt.
